title: Team members: every change is now recorded, and a person can be switched off and on
text: Groundwork for the team screens. Every action on a team member (added, powers changed, removed, switched off or on, password reset) is now written to a record that nobody can edit or delete. A person can be switched off and back on, unlike Remove, and if Tony Durante LLC switched someone off the owner cannot switch them back on. Adding a team member can no longer leave a half-made login behind after a double click. The screens do not change yet.
